comparison.objective: Move a patient from trolley to bed while maintaining contact until the rail is raised.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous support during a large-body transfer and rail operation versus precision bimanual impact tooling.
comparison.success_condition: Patient transferred and hand contact maintained until the rail is up; detailed safety thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests continuous guarding during transfer, not small-part fracture, insert retention, or debris recovery.
